nodes.description: Fuxi.maxLimit: public uint256 constant-style upper bound of 8888 tokens, read by claim() to cap supply.
Fuxi.numbers: private mapping(uint256=>uint256) storing the block.timestamp seed of each minted tokenId.
Fuxi.claim(): public nonReentrant mint entry point; computes tokenId = totalSupply()+1, stores block.timestamp and calls _safeMint(_msgSender(), tokenId).
Fuxi.tokenURI(uint256): assembles the 60-part SVG/JSON metadata and returns a base64 data URI.
Fuxi.getBackGround(uint256): loads the timestamp seed, derives a pseudo-random greatness value and returns the Color struct.
Fuxi.pluck(uint256,string,string[]): internal helper that hashes the token seed and indexes the given source array.
Fuxi.random(string): pure pseudo-random generator built on keccak256(abi.encodePacked(input)).
Fuxi.toString(uint256): pure uint256 to decimal string conversion used in metadata building.
Fuxi.getFiveElements(uint256): public view delegating to pluck with the fiveElements array.
Fuxi.getGossip(uint256): public view delegating to pluck with the gossip array.
Fuxi.getTenDry(uint256): public view delegating to pluck with the tenDry array.
Fuxi.geTearthlyBranch(uint256): public view delegating to pluck with the earthlyBranch array.
Fuxi constructor: initialises ERC721('Fuxi','FUXI') and Ownable (sets deployer as owner).
msg.sender (_msgSender()): attacker-controlled caller address, used as the mint recipient in claim().
block.timestamp: miner-influenced value stored as the per-token randomness seed in claim().
ERC721._safeMint -> _checkOnERC721Received -> IERC721Receiver(to).onERC721Received external callback that hands control to an arbitrary recipient contract.
numbers[tokenId] = block.timestamp: predictable timestamp-based seed assignment performed in claim().
Local tokenId computed in claim() as totalSupply()+1.
tokenId argument of getBackGround(uint256).
Local number = numbers[tokenId] read in getBackGround().
Local greatness = rand % 100 controlling the background colour branch in getBackGround().
tokenId argument of pluck(uint256,string,string[]).
Local number = numbers[tokenId] read in pluck().
Local rand produced by random() in pluck() and used modulo sourceArray.length.
tokenId argument of tokenURI(uint256).
Local output string progressively assembled and base64 encoded in tokenURI().
ERC721._owners: mapping(uint256=>address) mutated by _mint/_transfer during claim().
ERC721._balances: mapping(address=>uint256) incremented by _mint during claim().
ReentrancyGuard._status: guard flag set to _ENTERED/_NOT_ENTERED around claim().

edges.reason: claim() reads maxLimit to enforce the 8888 token upper bound.
claim() writes block.timestamp into the numbers mapping for the new tokenId.
claim() mints through _safeMint which updates _owners[tokenId].
claim() mints through _safeMint which increases _balances[to].
claim() is guarded by nonReentrant, which reads and writes _status.
claim() executes numbers[tokenId] = block.timestamp.
msg.sender is consumed by claim() as the recipient of _safeMint.
msg.sender becomes the `to` address of _safeMint, so an attacker contract receives the onERC721Received callback.
claim() stores block.timestamp as the token seed, making the token attributes miner-influenced.
block.timestamp is the value written into numbers by the seed-assignment operation.
The recipient's onERC721Received callback can re-enter claim() (blocked only by the nonReentrant modifier).
The timestamp seed assignment persists into the numbers mapping.
The block.timestamp-derived seed in numbers feeds random(), so token traits are predictable from the timestamp.
pluck() reads numbers[tokenId] as its randomness seed.
getBackGround() reads numbers[tokenId] as its randomness seed.
The local tokenId from claim() is used to index the numbers mapping.
The local tokenId from claim() is passed to _safeMint.
claim() invokes _safeMint, which performs an external call to the recipient contract.
tokenURI() calls getBackGround() to obtain the colour palette.
tokenURI() calls getFiveElements().
tokenURI() calls getGossip().
tokenURI() calls getTenDry().
tokenURI() calls geTearthlyBranch().
tokenURI() serialises the tokenId with toString() for the JSON name field.
tokenURI() uses its tokenId parameter throughout the metadata assembly.
tokenURI() builds and returns the local output string.
getBackGround() uses its tokenId parameter to look up the seed.
getBackGround() stores numbers[tokenId] in the local number variable.
getBackGround() derives the local greatness value from rand % 100.
getBackGround() reads the numbers mapping for the given tokenId.
getBackGround() calls random() to derive the trait seed.
getBackGround() converts tokenId+number with toString().
pluck() uses its tokenId parameter in the hash input.
pluck() stores numbers[tokenId] in the local number variable.
pluck() computes the local rand used for array indexing.
pluck() calls random() on the keyPrefix+tokenId+number string.
pluck() converts tokenId+number with toString().
random() returns the keccak256 hash that becomes rand in pluck().
getFiveElements() delegates to pluck().
getGossip() delegates to pluck().
getTenDry() delegates to pluck().
geTearthlyBranch() delegates to pluck().
The constructor registers the deployer via _msgSender() in Ownable._setOwner.

normalization_plan.reason: The tokenId local is a temporary of claim() with no independent identity; it only indexes numbers and feeds _safeMint.
The tokenId parameter is only meaningful inside getBackGround() and must be normalised into that function node.
The number local is an intermediate read of numbers[tokenId] fully determined by getBackGround().
The greatness local is a transient modulo result used only for the colour branch in getBackGround().
The tokenId parameter is a local binding of pluck() and should be folded into it.
The number local is a transient read of numbers[tokenId] inside pluck().
The rand local is a transient hash output used only for array indexing inside pluck().
The tokenId parameter is only consumed inside tokenURI() and carries no separate semantics.
The output local is the accumulated metadata string produced entirely within tokenURI().
